gloss: sacred place; holy site; spiritual ground

definitions.gloss: sacred place; holy site; spiritual ground
definitions.explanation: A place considered to have spiritual significance or divine power, often associated with shrines, temples, or natural sites believed to house deities or spirits.

examples.japanese: この{山|やま}は{古|ふる}くからの{霊地|れいち}だ。
examples.english: This mountain has been a sacred place since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {霊地|れいち}を{巡|めぐ}る{旅|たび}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: I set out on a journey visiting sacred places.

examples.japanese: {熊野|くまの}は{日本|にほん}を{代表|だいひょう}する{霊地|れいち}のひとつで、{多|おお}くの{巡礼者|じゅんれいしゃ}が{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Kumano is one of Japan's most renowned sacred places, and many pilgrims visit there.

notes:
Composed of {霊|れい} (spirit, soul) + {地|ち} (place, ground). Refers to locations believed to have spiritual power or divine significance in Shinto, Buddhism, or folk religion.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has many famous {霊地|れいち}, including mountain peaks, ancient forests, waterfalls, and temple/shrine complexes. These are often destinations for pilgrimage ({巡礼|じゅんれい}) and spiritual practice ({修行|しゅぎょう}). Examples include {高野山|こうやさん}, {熊野|くまの}, and {出羽三山|でわさんざん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {霊地|れいち}を{巡|めぐ}る: to visit sacred places
- {霊地|れいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい}: pilgrimage to sacred places
- {古|いにしえ}の{霊地|れいち}: an ancient holy site

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {聖地|せいち}: holy land, sacred place — often used for both religious and secular "mecca" (e.g., anime pilgrimage sites)
- {霊場|れいじょう}: sacred place of worship — specifically a pilgrimage site, often part of a numbered circuit
- {霊山|れいざん}: sacred mountain
